column2: The Skullcannon digs in, shrieking skulls arcing high over wall and field. It cannot move while deployed.
column3: 颅骨魔炮掘地而守，将尖啸颅骨抛向远方的城墙与军阵。架设期间无法移动。

column2: The Skullcannon tears free and lumbers back into the hunt, trading great arcs for armour-piercing shot.
column3: 颅骨魔炮挣脱驻地，重返猎杀，以穿甲直射撕碎近敌。

column2: A Skullcannon dug in as a fixed siege howitzer. Its bound flesh strains and screams, hurling skulls in great arcs, heedless of all beneath.
column3: 架设为固定攻城炮的颅骨魔炮。被束缚的血肉尖啸着，将颅骨高高抛起，不分敌我，唯血神见证。
